name: trace
description: Displays and logs debugging data about the state of an application at the time this function executes.
syntax: trace( [string var], [string text], [string type], [string category], [boolean inline], [boolean abort], [boolean follow] )

params.name: var
params.description: The name of a simple or complex variable to display. Useful for displaying a temporary value, or a value that does not display on any CFM page.

params.name: text
params.description: string, which can include simple variable, but not complex variables such as arrays.

params.name: type
params.description:
Corresponds to the cflog type attribute:

- Information
- Warning
- Error
- Fatal Information

params.name: category
params.description: string name for identifying trace groups

params.name: inline
params.description:
if true displays trace code in line on the page in the location of the trace function,
addition to the debugging information output.

params.name: abort
params.description: stops further processing of the request.

params.name: follow
params.description: If true, Lucee follows the variable defined in the [var] attribute and will log any changes to it. Ignored when attribute [var] is not defined.
